pages.title: Events (Papierkorb: "Events · Papierkorb")
pages.purpose: Browse upcoming/past events, filter by status, open an event, bulk-trash, reach the trash.

fields.name: view
fields.label: Kommend · Vergangen · Alle
fields.notes: aria-label eventsPage.when; hidden in trash view

fields.name: status
fields.label: Status
fields.notes: Entwurf / Veröffentlicht / Abgesagt; hidden in trash view

sections.title: Events
sections.notes: Row → /events/<id>. Tick boxes for events.manage (not in trash). Trash view shows eventsPage.trashHint ('Gelöschte Events werden nach 30 Tagen endgültig entfernt.').

pages.empty: EmptyState: 'Noch keine Events.' / 'Lege eine Veranstaltung an, verkaufe Tickets oder sammle Anmeldungen und plane Schichten und Gästeliste dazu.' + button 'Neues Event'. Filtered/past/all: plain 'Noch keine Events.' Trash: 'Der Papierkorb ist leer.'
pages.phone: DataTable as cards (no tick boxes, no bulk bar); primary as round + by the tab bar.
uxNotes: The view switch (Kommend/Vergangen/Alle) is a hand-built chip nav instead of the shared <Segments> component that docs/design/app.md prescribes for ≤ 5 views; it sits left next to the search, not right (ml-auto).
Filtered empty result reuses 'Noch keine Events.' even when events exist but do not match the filter (no 'Keine Events gefunden.').
No ExportMenu on the list (other lists like contacts have one).
Restoring from the trash is only possible on the event page, the trash list has no restore bulk action.

pages.title: Neues Event
pages.purpose: Create an event (title, time, place, description, links, slug, mail template).

fields.name: location
fields.label: Ort
fields.notes: only when the org has locations

fields.name: description
fields.label: Beschreibung
fields.notes: plain text, max 20000, no visible label (aria-label only)

sections.title: Links

fields.name: link_label_0..2
fields.label: Titel
fields.notes: 3 fixed rows, placeholder 'Telegram' in the first

sections.notes: Description eventsPage.linksHint: up to 3 links shown as buttons on the event page.

fields.name: email_template
fields.label: Vorlage
fields.notes: only with email module + email.view and when templates exist; hint eventsPage.emailsHint names the fallback

uxNotes: Label drift: page title 'Neues Event' but the create button says 'Veranstaltung anlegen'; 'Event' and 'Veranstaltung' are mixed.
Two fields labelled 'Ort': the location Choice (locations.title) and the free venue name (eventsPage.venueName).
On error the whole form is re-rendered empty (redirect with ?error=, no useActionState), so typed input is lost.
Description is a plain Textarea while other long texts (projects, letters) use <RichTextEditor>.

pages.title: <Event title>
pages.purpose: Edit all event details, image and files; publish/unpublish, cancel, trash; restore if trashed.

actions.label: Öffentliche Seite
actions.notes: only when status != draft and not trashed

primary.label: Veröffentlichen | Zurück zu Entwurf
primary.notes: a SubmitButton, not a link; outline variant when published; hidden when cancelled or trashed

sections.title: Tabs (layout)
sections.notes: events/[eventId]/layout.tsx renders a NavLink tab row: Übersicht · Lineup & Timetable · Tickets (module tickets + tickets.view) · Gästelisten (module guestlists + guestlists.view). Hidden for trashed events.

sections.title: Event form
sections.notes: Same EventForm as /events/new (Titel & Zeit, Wo, Beschreibung, Links, Öffentliche Seite, E-Mails) with SaveBar (appears on change). Fieldset disabled without events.manage, plus line 'Du kannst Events ansehen, aber nicht bearbeiten.'

fields.name: file
fields.label: Bild
fields.notes: hint 'PNG, JPG, WebP oder GIF, max. 2 MB.'; remove option

sections.title: Absagen
sections.notes: aside card, only when published + events.manage; description eventsPage.cancelConfirm ('Event wirklich absagen? Wer es abonniert hat (Webhooks, Telegram), wird informiert.')

sections.title: Trashed state
sections.notes: If deleted_at: only a box 'Gelöscht am …, wird am … endgültig entfernt.' + button 'Wiederherstellen' (events.manage). No tabs, no form.

actions.label: Absagen
actions.result: toast 'Abgesagt.'; subscribers notified; publish button disappears

actions.label: Wiederherstellen
actions.result: toast 'Wiederhergestellt.'; error errors.slug_taken if the address was reused

pages.phone: RecordLayout stacks: form first, then Dateien / Bild / Absagen cards; tab row scrolls horizontally; primary (publish) is a form button, so it is not a link-based round + button.
uxNotes: 'Absagen' is a destructive, notifying action (webhooks/Telegram) with no data-confirm: the card's description is phrased as a question ('Event wirklich absagen?') but the button submits immediately.
Cancelling is a red card in the aside (danger-zone style), which docs/design/app.md rules out (destructive items belong in the ⋯ menu).
Once cancelled there is no UI to un-cancel: the publish/draft primary is hidden for cancelled events.
The event layout wraps pages in a plain div (max-w-6xl) instead of <Page size=record>; tabs are a NavLink row, while docs/design/app.md says new sub-pages belong into the nav tree, not a tab bar.
Status, image, and form are three separate save paths on one page (header button, image form, SaveBar).
Shifts and Einlass for the event are only in the ⋯ menu, guest lists/tickets are tabs: related event parts are split between tabs and menu.

pages.title: Lineup & Timetable
pages.purpose: Plan the event's timetable: slots with artist or title, stage and times; edit artists; create an artist guest list.

urlState.meaning: toast / error inside the open sheet

sections.title: Lineup & Timetable
columns: Act (artist name or title, '· title', badge 'intern' if not public)
sections.notes: Row → ?slot=<id> (events.manage only). Section heading h2 + button 'Neuer Slot' (events.manage).

overlays.title: Neuer Slot | <artist name or slot title>

actions.label: Neuer Slot / Speichern
actions.result: toast 'Gespeichert.', sheet closes; needs artist or title (lineup.needArtistOrTitle)

actions.label: Artist bearbeiten
actions.notes: only when the slot has an artist

actions.label: Gästeliste für Artist
actions.result: → /guestlists/<id> (existing or new list '<Artist> +', quota 5, link on)

fields.name: links
fields.label: Links (einer pro Zeile)
fields.notes: only http(s) URLs kept, max 10, invalid lines dropped silently

pages.phone: Table as cards; sheets full width.
uxNotes: 'Slot löschen' is a hard delete without confirm, shown as a ghost button at the bottom of the sheet (not in a ⋯ menu).

Artist picker is a NativeSelect of up to 1000 artists, against the rule 'pickers search on the server, never load all rows into a select'; free 'or new artist' input next to it is a second path to the same value.
Artists have no page or list of their own: they can only be edited via a slot that uses them (?artist only reachable from a slot sheet), and cannot be deleted in the UI.
Artist 'Links' field is a raw textarea where invalid lines are silently dropped.
Read-only users see the table but rows are not clickable and give no detail view.

pages.title: Tickets
pages.purpose: Set up ticket types, price tiers, codes/discount links, shop and door settings; see sold tickets and the waiting list.

header.notes: header from the event layout; the page adds its own h2 'Tickets' row with buttons

urlState.meaning: search sold tickets by code or holder name
valid | used | reserved | void (default: all except reserved)
type = new ticket type sheet; code = new code sheet

sections.title: Tickets (summary row)
sections.notes: Buttons 'Scannen' (→ /scan?event=<id>, tickets.scan) and 'Ticketshop' (public page, only when published). Line '{sold} verkauft · {checkedIn} eingecheckt' + per type, guest list and member counts. Box tickets.notPublished when the event is not published.

sections.title: Ticketarten
columns: Ticketart (+ badges Pausiert/versteckt, tier names 'A → B')
sections.notes: Only shop types (not guest-list or member types). Row → ?edit=<id> (tickets.manage). Button 'Neue Ticketart' → ?new=type.

fields.name: show_code_field
fields.label: Feld für Rabattcodes im Shop anzeigen

fields.name: methods
fields.label: Zahlungsarten
fields.notes: cash / qr / terminal (labels door.sale.method.*); unavailable ones disabled with reason door.settings.unavailable.*

fields.name: reader_id
fields.label: Kartenterminal
fields.notes: only when terminal is possible; 'Kein Terminal'; no readers → 'Noch kein Terminal gekoppelt.' + link 'Zu den Integrationen'

fields.name: cash_account_id
fields.label: Kassenbuch-Konto für Barzahlungen
fields.notes: cashbook module only; 'Nicht ins Kassenbuch buchen'; hint door.settings.cashAccountHint

sections.title: Verkaufte Tickets
sections.notes: Row → /payments?edit=<order_id> when payments module + payments.view. Pager.

sections.title: Warteliste
sections.notes: Only rendered when there are entries (waiting/offered/claimed/expired, max 500). Hint waitlist.hint.

actions.label: Freigeschaltet durch: <code> links + 'Neuer Code'
actions.notes: only for hidden types; red text tickets.noUnlockCode when none

actions.label: Preisstufen: per tier 'Speichern' / 'Löschen', new row 'Stufe hinzufügen'
actions.result: stays on ?edit=<type>, toast 'Gespeichert.' / 'Ticketart gelöscht.' (sic, also for a tier); tier fields: name, price, quota, sales_end, position (number)

actions.label: Ticketart löschen
actions.result: toast 'Ticketart gelöscht.'; blocked with tickets.typeHasTickets when sold

fields.name: kind
fields.label: Rabatt
fields.notes: Prozent / Betrag in € / Kein Rabatt (nur freischalten)

actions.label: Code löschen
actions.notes: inside a red 'Gefahrenzone' box; the code's link is shown above as text

pages.empty: Types: 'Noch keine Ticketarten. Lege z. B. „Normal“ und „Ermäßigt“ an.' Codes: 'Noch keine Codes. Codes geben Rabatt oder schalten versteckte Ticketarten frei; jeder Code hat einen Link.' Sold: 'Noch keine Tickets verkauft.' Waitlist section hidden when empty.
pages.phone: All tables become cards; long single page with 6 sections; sheets full width.
uxNotes: Overloaded page: types, shop settings, door settings, codes, sold tickets and waiting list on one scroll page, each with its own save button or sheet; Abendkasse settings belong to Einlass/Verkauf but live here.
Two inline settings forms use explicit 'Speichern' buttons instead of <SaveBar>, and one sheet (ticket type) contains four independent forms (type SaveBar, each tier row, pause, delete).
'Gefahrenzone' boxes (admin.dangerZone) in the type and code sheets contradict docs/design/app.md ('no danger-zone boxes', delete belongs in ⋯ with confirm).
Delete ticket type, delete code, delete tier and remove from waiting list run without confirm.
Wrong toast: deleting a code or a tier shows 'Ticketart gelöscht.' (tickets.deleted).
Prices use a plain Input inputMode=decimal, not <TypedInput kind=money>; selects are NativeSelect instead of <Choice>; status filter is a hand-built chip nav instead of <Segments>.
Sold ticket rows jump to /payments?edit=<order> (another area's drawer) and are not clickable without payments.view; there is no per-ticket view, void or resend action here.
Waitlist column headers reuse public-facing labels 'Dein Name' / 'Deine E-Mail' (waitlist.name/email) in the back office.
'Scannen' button label differs from the nav label 'Einlass' for the same route.

pages.title: Gästelisten
pages.purpose: See the event's guest lists plus permanent ones and start a new list for this event.

sections.title: Gästelisten
sections.notes: GuestListTable from guestlists/table.tsx inside a FormCard; row → /guestlists/<id>.

uxNotes: Tab content leaves the event: rows and 'Neue Gästeliste' go to the Gästelisten area, so the event tabs and breadcrumbs are lost.
Uses a FormCard as a list container (FormCard is meant for form groups).
